edits.new: The report text is for the wave entry check and is not part of the message standard. No S1 rule ID is in force for this feature, so the harness asserts the state, the data, the interface run and the record the owner writes, and names a message ID only where an owning service returns one. The order to SVAF is raised through rwb-integration, which owns the SVAF interface and its retries; the decision record carries the order date, the rule version and the limit applied.
